in_sanskrit.name: Bipan
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Wise, Intelligent
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Bipan एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Vipan', meaning 'wisdom'. In Hindu mythology, 'Vipan' is considered a sage and a wise advisor. The name 'Bipan' is a modern variation and carries the same symbolism of wisdom and intelligence.
